title: Robust principal component analysis with rank and cardinality regularization under matrix factorization
summary: Robust principal component analysis is an important representative method in data analysis. It is usually viewed as an optimization problem involving the rank and $\ell_0$-norm of matrices. In this paper, we study the rank and $\ell_0$ regularized optimization problem and its matrix factorization problem. We establish their equivalences on global minimizers and stationary points, respectively.
